title: Phobos stores data pack

priority.description: Override files only: files apply lowest first (default 0), so a higher number has a later word. Leave it out unless you need it.

notes.description: Free text for maintainers; ignored by the game.

requireInteraction.description: The interaction a container must offer to count as a store, such as the game's Inventory; empty for any.

excludeConditions.description: Conditions that mark an object as not a store, such as IsShipWeapon or IsToilet01.

excludeContainers.description: Container rules that hold only one kind of thing, such as TIsFitAmmo20mm; a name ending in * covers every rule that starts with the rest.

description: Which of the game's containers are not stores: weapons, chargers, filter holders and toilets are left out of store pickers, crew orders and housekeeping, and crew never take from them.
